paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Fine-tuned LLaMA & Mistral in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the win rate percentages of different models when pitted against each other. It contains two rings with four total slices, two per ring, each labeled with the name of the model and its respective win rate percentage. The models shown are GPT-4o, Mistral, and LLaMA, with GPT-4o having two segments, one in each ring. In the outer ring, the segment for GPT-4o is colored in dark blue and has a win rate of 19.6%, while LLaMA has a win rate of 80.4%. Another segment for GPT-4o in the inner circle shows a win rate of 12.0% and is colored in red. The Mistral segment is in a lighter shade and has a win rate of 88.0%. Percentages are included within the labels, and there is no separate legend. The chart does not visually emphasize any slices through offsetting or bolding, and the segments appear to be ordered by size within the chart itself.
